title: Beautiful stars
description: The mod adds star customization options such as size, number, twinkling, and large star.
body:
This mod allows you to flexibly customize the stars in the sky, such as their size, flickering, and number. 
There's also a large star that can be customized. 
The settings are accessed by pressing B. 
Here's an example of how to customize them. 
![Here's one example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fba7bf62e28022bad614e713dc450320158b9cef_0.webp)
